observed: The dialog is titled "Reassign lead technician", has a Search technicians box and one list of the location's technicians with avatars and "N open"; there is no Unassigned row and the only button is Cancel.
The Office User, the deactivated technician and the technician of another location are not offered.
Clicking a technician closes the dialog at once and moves the card, with "<number> assigned to <technician>" and Undo; Unassign shows "<number> moved to Unassigned" with Undo.
On a work order with no lead the menu says "Assign lead technician" and the dialog has that title; Cancel changes nothing and the page shows no lead.
In Tech View the "Assign lead technician" dialog offers the same technicians and assigns at once.
